notes.title: Bugfix Patch - 2022-07-26
notes.content:
Hi doods!

Just another small update!

Changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where players could not access the Innocent Warehouse from the Item World when using the keyboard to play.
[*]Fixed an issue where some users of Windows 8.1 would not be able to enter names manually.
[/list]

Happy grinding!

notes.title: Bugfix Patch - 2022-07-05
notes.content:
Hello doods,

We have an update for you!

Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where certain controller-like hardware was being taken as the first controller over the expected controller. Now it'll try to choose the Steam-connected controller first.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could not save if they have certain non-ASCII characters in their Windows username.
[*]Added a configuration setting to produce a crash dump on crashes. If you are experiencing crashes, go to [b]C:\Users\<Username>\AppData\Roaming\Nippon Ichi Software, Inc\Disgaea 6 Complete\[/b], open the ID folder inside, and find the Setting.ini file, and add the following text:
[code][Helper]
CrashDumpLevel = 2[/code] The game will then produce crash dumps in the game local files.[/list]

Happy dungeoning!

notes.title: Disgaea 6 Complete will screech onto Steam on June 28th
notes.content:
Elden Ring hides its open world's beauty behind a layer of difficulty, sure, but it's nothing compared to the Disgaea series. These colourful JRPGs have been hiding some of the deepest and most satisfying levelling systems in all of gaming behind the world's most obnoxious anime characters for years now.

The next brutal gauntlet is Disgaea 6 Complete, with a newly announced released date of June 28th. There's also a new character trailer below, which sets out its stall. Can you survive it?

Read more

notes.title: Disgaea 6 Complete heading to Steam this summer
notes.content:
Each new Disgaea game is a new opportunity to finally get into the strange, brash and thousand-layers deep JRPG series. I've yet to manage it, but now Disgaea 6 is making its way to PC. Called Disgaea 6 Complete, it bundles last year's Switch and PS4 game together with its character and cosmetic DLC. You can find the announcement trailer below.
